report.summary: Food resource options for patient P-D005. Recent AHC screener (2026-10-22) shows no food insecurity (food_worry: never_true; food_ran_out: never_true), so these are listed as available community options. Eligibility noted where stated on the resource pages.

options.name: Saturday Market Pantry
options.how_to_access: Saturdays 9 AM–noon; Cook County residents only.
